 Games Leaving PlayStation Plus in December 2026 Confirmed
 November 16, 2026 
 By
 Zarmena Khan 
 PS Store has revealed the list of games leaving PS Plus Extra and Premium in December 2026, as the November lineup has begun rolling out in regions where it’s midday Tuesday, the 17th. As we predicted , Granblue Fantasy: Relink headlines the games departing next month.
 List of games leaving PS Plus Extra, Premium in December (as of November 17, 2026)
 This list has been obtained from the Japanese and Asian PS Stores. Expect other regions to have the same list when their respective stores update at noon (local time) on Tuesday. There may be slight variations, which we’ll highlight in this article as and when they come up.
 Granblue Fantasy: Relink
 Somerville
 Fade to Silence 
 Dark Rose Valkyrie
 Root Letter (select regions)
 Jake Hunter: Prism of Eyes (select regions)
 The games listed above will leave the service by Tuesday, December 15, when next month’s Extra and Premium lineups are added to the catalog.
 Do note that Sony sometimes updates the PS Store’s Last Chance to Play section during the month. We’ll keep an eye on the tab and share an updated list should that happen.
 As usual, we’ll share our predictions for January 2027’s Last Chance to Play update sometime in early December.
